text:
Ana (CS): FYI - I sketched a 'soft-landing' runbook for low-touch accounts that hit livemode. Trying to keep it lean: short activation window, small prewarm, streaming fallback, and a lightweight renewal-risk signal capture. feedback pls
Liam (SRE): love the name. can you drop the checklist here? easier to iterate. :thumbsup:
Ana (CS): sure — pasting condensed checklist below. want to confirm sequencing with @Jules and @Tess
Ana (CS): 1) 24h activation window (day 0-1): init prewarm pool 2) Prefill up to 3 common prompts (micro-cache) 3) Enable streaming for UI latency 4) Monitor token burn and error spikes 5) Capture renewal signals: engagement drop, quota burn, error rate
Tess (Enablement): can we standardize the 3 prompts pattern? AE teams ask which ones to use. propose: auth flow prompt, sample user query, fallback probe
Maya (CS): +1 on probe prompt. Also add a quick customer-facing note: "what to expect 0-72h" one-liner for AE emails
Jules (Eng): technical checks: ensure KV prefix cache TTL = 30m, batching target = 50ms latency budget, and streaming chunk size = 512 tokens max. if any of those are missing, fallback to single-request path
Liam (SRE): operational hooks: set an alert for 5xx rate > 1% over 5m AND token burn > baseline *1.5. runbook step: if alert fires, flip to degraded mode (smaller batch, no scheduled prefill)
Ana (CS): quick example prefill curl we recommend to partners:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/requests \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-v1","input":"<probe prompt>","stream":false}'
```
Jules (Eng): also include a tiny health-check endpoint we add to the onboarding checklist: "/v1/internal/warmup-status?tenant_id=" returns {ready: true|false, pool_size: N} (we'll keep this internal to AE/SRE)
Raj (PM): on renewal signals — can we map engagement tiers to risk buckets? low-touch = < 3 sessions/day, medium = 3-10, high >10. flag 'at-risk' if sessions drop one tier in 7 days
Maya (CS): add behavioral triggers: new feature untested (0 streams in 14d), token spike with co-occurring errors, and stalling UI loads > 500ms for 10% of requests
Tess (Enablement): I'll draft the AE email snippet and a one-pager for customers: 1) what we do 2) what we expect 3) how to escalate. will post draft tomorrow
Ana (CS): escalation paths: Primary AE -> CS Ops -> Eng Oncall. Include on-call runbook links and the deploy-bot shortcut to request immediate capacity bump
onboard-bot: Capacity bump request created: ticket #CB-4827, ETA 15m (auto-escalate if not acked in 10m) :gear:
Liam (SRE): small note — if you call the capacity bump, the autoscaler will still respect commit caps. use it only for critical go-live windows
Jules (Eng): one more engineering tip: for streaming fallbacks, prefer incremental partial responses (send final tokens as chunks) rather than whole-response retries. cuts perceived latency
Ana (CS): thanks everyone. next steps: Tess to produce AE-ready copy, Jules to confirm TTLs and internal health endpoint, Liam to codify alerts, Raj to add risk mapping to renewal dashboard. I'll consolidate into a single shareable runbook and loop in legal for the customer note
Maya (CS): would be good to include two short FAQ items: "why did my prefill tokens increase?" and "when will streaming be disabled?" — I'll draft answers
Tess (Enablement): rough ETA for AE copy: EOD tomorrow. will ping this thread when done :eyes:
Ana (CS): solid. once AE copy is done we can pilot with two low-touch accounts this week and capture feedback via a 72h check-in survey
Raj (PM): add a short feedback capture snippet for the survey: 3 quick questions (latency acceptable Y/N, output quality OK Y/N, any blocking errors Y/N) and a free-text box
Ana (CS): perfect. saved. I'll push final version to the onboarding playbook repo after edits. thanks all :rocket:
